text: It has been said by ancient writers that to be pinched by adversity or pampered by prosperity is the common lot of men... nature has so ordered it that while they desire everything, it is impossible for them to have everything, and thus their desires being always in excess of their capacity to gratify them, they remain constantly dissatisfied and discontented.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
reference: Discourses on the First Decade of Titus Livius
